## Reservations I made for later domains (reservations/ops.json)

- `chat_messages` keys `llm-chat-01`..`llm-chat-14`: the assistant message produced by llm_calls (see the chat list above; `chat_messages.llm_call_id` must be that call id and created_at its finish time).
- `drafts` keys `rev-elderglen-demo-reply` (the unapproved Slack reply, storyline 2) and `rev-saltmere-blueprint-email` (storyline 1): their `doc_json` must equal the last `content_revisions` row of field doc_json for that entity_id (revisions 1..3 and 1..2); first revision is the engine draft, later ones user edits (autosave bursts).
- content_revisions also hold the description of work items wi-007 and wi-021 (text field `description`; their last revision is the current description).
